The protein kinase-like domain in PAN complex subunits appears to not be a kinase
This might be a problem because its in [PF00069](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/pfam/PF00069)
(which nobody probably wants to touch!)

but also correctly in https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/pfam/PF18101/

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Val,
Thank you very much for this. Indeed [PF00069](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/pfam/PF00069) is a too massive entry to manage to fix this without breaking anything else. I've remove the kinase term from IPR000719 and added it to some children/grandchildren that didn't have it yet. The changes will be available in the next InterPro release.
Best,
Beatriz
